scope: Twelve named argument families in the current research spine, not every repository file or every historical conversation.

applications.application: PA3-5 replace the whole-disk triangle test on 46 larger rectangles while retaining every completion and source remainder.
applications.remaining: A source-specific all-height or off-line exhaustion theorem is still absent.

applications.application: Retain the xi normalizer, four unique root disks, full binary partition, and exact reflected zero sets.
applications.remaining: No equal-modulus law for F; no new all-height coverage.

applications.application: A zero count of one is required; phase symmetry or a nonzero beam center cannot exclude a double-zero collision.
applications.remaining: No global zero-simplicity or no-collision theorem.

applications.application: PA6 and PA9 retain ordered mixed terms; a phase change or taper without its complement changes the actual source.
applications.remaining: exists B>=0 forall N: sum_(n=2..N)(4n+7/3)|ell_n|^2<=B remains unproved.

applications.family: Bessel approximation, prefix and high-source tails
applications.application: All existing paid differences stay paid at their own written grade. Tapering introduces its own exact complementary source.
applications.remaining: The retained middle sequence is not a sidelobe error and remains unpaid.

applications.family: Signed covariance and Newton divisor updates
applications.application: Beam weights cannot be chosen as if Mobius coefficients were free. Use only exact reconstruction on the proved gate and retain correction squares.
applications.remaining: Residual support-doubling does not imply a weighted-norm contraction.

applications.family: Hodge centers, Schur complements and regularization
applications.application: PA7 exposes source-independent inverse conditioning; diagonal loading requires the explicit resolvent difference.
applications.remaining: A source-visible lower bound or restricted decoder estimate is not supplied by positive diagonals.

applications.family: FK hull phase coordinates and small divisors
applications.application: Composite logarithmic modes satisfy exact multiplicative phase relations. An independent-phase FK realization is not obtained by labels.
applications.remaining: A source-derived hull, compatibility/neutral mode, and quantitative inverse bounds remain necessary.

applications.application: Nonuniform log k frequencies and arbitrary arithmetic weights are not a uniform cosine potential. Any operator replacement requires its difference bound.
applications.remaining: No transfer of a spectral gap or localization theorem to the arithmetic input.

applications.application: PA8 distinguishes common from differential phase. Operator/readout transport and every repeated use retain their full cost.
applications.remaining: Isometric scans do not reduce an invariant source norm.

applications.application: Complete tight-frame Parseval preserves energy. PA7 gives lambda_min<=T^2/(6n^2) for adjacent log frequencies at fixed aperture.
applications.remaining: Neither finite rank, one favorable beam, nor a finite coefficient prefix establishes uniform reconstruction.

applications.application: Use a proven Bernstein outer enclosure plus every analytic tail; proposed readout phases and margins are independently replayed.
applications.remaining: A sampled uncertainty ellipse is not automatically a whole-cell bound; native Lean remains unavailable.
